system.description:
When you take this, choose a persona. The Mind: +1 Talent Point in Smarts, -1 Core Skill Point in Heart. The Monster: +1 Talent Point in Grit, -1 Core Skill Point in Wit. Once per Doom Quarter you may try a CR 3 check to switch persona: Smarts as The Mind, Heart as The Monster.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.47
system.summary: When you take this, choose a persona. The Mind: +1 Talent Point in Smarts, -1 Core Skill Point in Heart. The Monster: +1 Talent Point in Grit, -1 Core Skill Point in Wit. Once per Doom Quarter you may try a CR 3 check to switch persona: Smarts as The Mind, Heart as The Monster.

automation.note: When unlocking, give the Talent Point to Smarts (The Mind) or Grit (The Monster), then remove 1 Core Point from Heart (Mind) or Wit (Monster) on your skill tracker. Roll the first button as The Mind, the second as The Monster. After a switch, move the Talent Point (edit this ability's talentPoints rule) and the lost Core Point by hand.
